snippet.title: Brainrotting - Official Trailer
snippet.description:
WISHLIST ON STEAM! https://store.steampowered.com/app/4484320/Brainrotting/
PLAY THE DEMO ON STEAM OR ITCH! https://cr4zygames.itch.io/brainrotting

Brainrotting is a "scroller" desktop sim about doomscrolling or solving minigames, getting upgrades and eventually automating your dopamine generation.

Features:
 - Deep Automation: Transition from manual gameplay to autoscrollers and autosolvers with multiple screens.
 - Doomscroll Simulation: A unique take on the idle genre featuring an interactive "desktop" interface.

#Brainrotting #IdleGame #IndieDev #MemeGame
